description: Shows one pack in detail: odds and value range per rarity, buyback rate, how many cards of each rarity are left, and the 10 most valuable cards in its pool right now with the chance per pack of pulling each one. Use it when the user names or picks a pack; use list_packs to compare packs and estimate_budget to see what spending a set amount on this pack usually returns. Read-only; pool cards are rescanned every few minutes and can be pulled by anyone at any time.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

name: get_pack

buyback_pct.description: Share of a card's insured value paid if sold back within 72 hours.

odds_pct.description: Chance per pack of each rarity, in percent.

value_range_usd.description: Card value range per rarity as [low, high] in US$.

title: One pack in detail
